Analysis: While Hypothesis 1 introduces a highly novel and conceptually innovative inter‐organ communication approach using time‐synchronized gene editing and chronotherapy, its complexity raises serious concerns regarding mechanistic clarity, feasibility, and safety. In contrast, Hypothesis 2, which builds on the well‐established benefits of dietary polyphenols to mitigate oxidative stress and modulate PPARβ/δ signaling, offers a clearer and more plausible pathway. Its reliance on dietary supplementation and established molecular methods enhances testability and safety, despite being slightly less striking in novelty. Overall, Hypothesis 2 better balances innovation with experimental feasibility and safety.
